2.0 as in the latest version. there is a more "ordinary" deflection staff in the original game.

Some wizards are terrible at dodging, or simply too lazy to use their shielding spells. Such wizards crafted the Deflection Staff, able to repel incoming lethal projectiles. Now comes the next step in laziness, the Deflection Staff 2.0, which constantly deflects any projectiles sent in the direction of the wielder. #PA;Deflection Aura #AA;None
空虚寂寞冷，羡慕嫉妒恨... #PA;无 #AA;大量魅惑

Lonely wizards often bring this staff to parties in the hopes of quickly making new friends -- which actually works! But only for a short time, leaving the wizard lonely again soon thereafter. #PA;None #AA;Mass charm

A ridiculously popular staff among wizards. Whether they are going to parties, holiday celebrations, heading out into the wilderness or going on "diplomatic" missions into Goblin territories, wizards never mind bringing the Sausage Staff with them. #PA;None #AA;Sausage Rain

"First shalt thou take out the Holy Pin. Then shalt thou count to three, no more, no less. Three shall be the number thou shalt count, and the number of the counting shall be three. Once the number three, being the third number, be reached, then lobbest thou thy Holy Hand Grenade of Antioch towards thy foe, who, being naughty in my sight, shall snuff it. " #PA;None #AA;Holy Hand Grenade of Antioch
来自地狱深处的锻造工艺, 到底是地狱还是深渊啊？ #PA;None #AA;火弩箭

Forged in the most hellish of places, possibly the west wing of Castle Aldrheim. This staff is shunned by many wizards due to its evil nature. Many wizards also tend to avoid them since burnt wizards generally shun fire. #PA;None #AA;Firebolt

Spoofs Batman and Robin where Mr. Freeze (from which the Freeze Ray gun is designed from) who claims very cheesy'ly that ice killed the dinosaurs which sounds very stupid when he says it.

Partially Snowy Plains is an actual place on the campaign map of Midgård. The quote spoofs Warcrafts "Whomsoever takes up this blade shall wield power eternal. Just as the blade rends flesh, so must power scar the spirit.", describing Frostmourne.

A very fine-looking sword made out of strange materials. Sometimes, merry whispers can be heard from the sword. It was once found on a pedestal in the Partially Snowy Plains, and upon that pedestal these words were inscribed: "Whomsoever takes up this blade shall wield power eternal. Just as the blade rends flesh, so must power rejuvinate the spirit." #DMG;Medium Cold #SP;None
